stock.description: Watts International Maritime Company Limited functions as an investment holding enterprise, delivering a broad spectrum of engineering services throughout the People's Republic of China, encompassing port, waterway, marine, and municipal public works. Its business activities are segmented into two main areas: Marine Construction and Municipal Public Construction. The Marine Construction division focuses on developing essential port infrastructure, undertaking waterway engineering, and providing other associated services. In contrast, the Municipal Public Construction division is responsible for urban public infrastructure development, city landscaping, and building construction. Established in 2017 with its headquarters in Shanghai, PRC, the company adopted its current name, Watts International Maritime Company Limited, in January 2022, having previously been known as Watts International Maritime Engineering Limited.
